visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate anchors for the shelf establishing frame, participant routine, routine choice hub, routine fold, closure arrival, first response hub, visible ecological retaliation, coalition hub, totality threshold, and each ending family. visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Every base image prompt describes a complete frame with visible geometry, lighting, bodies, interfaces, and props for a general image model. Character refs are assembled only for characters visible in that frame. Continuity notes remain tooling constraints.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Style: intricate ecological science-fantasy storybook illustration, luminous ink and mineral pigments, restrained cold blue and amber bioluminescence, tactile bark resin fungus and translucent membranes, clear nonhuman silhouettes, humane dry wit beneath political tension, cinematic composition designed for interactive-fiction replay.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble every render prompt from global_style_cue, that scene's base_image_prompt, visual refs for only the named characters or groups listed as visible, and triggered state_image_modifiers plus global_branch_image_modifiers. A fresh render receives the full assembled prompt and does not depend on prior image memory.
